description: California EDD offers separate unemployment and disability programs. Choose the claim that fits whether you are available for work or unable to work because of a qualifying condition.
introduction: California EDD offers separate unemployment and disability programs. Choose the claim that fits whether you are available for work or unable to work because of a qualifying condition.

sections.who: Unemployment requires sufficient covered wages and weekly eligibility, including ability and availability for work. Disability Insurance requires its own wage, disability and medical-certification screening; the same application does not cover both.
sections.get: Each program replaces part of qualifying lost earnings. EDD determines the award and required ongoing certifications.
sections.docs: For unemployment, gather employer, work-history and earnings information. For Disability Insurance, prepare the disability-start date and licensed health professional’s details.
sections.apply:
1. Use EDD to access myEDD: UI Online for unemployment or SDI Online for disability.

  2. For unemployment, certify every two weeks. For disability, submit your portion and obtain medical certification; EDD generally instructs filing between day 9 and day 49 after disability begins. Save the receipt number for the health professional.
sections.after: Watch EDD messages and respond to eligibility requests. Report work and income as directed. Filing a claim or receiving an account number does not establish approval.
sections.sources:
Application and program details: Unemployment eligibility, Disability claim process, SDI filing instructions.

Historical screenshots and background: USA Assistance. Screenshots may show an earlier application interface.

faqs: Is disability claimed in UI Online?
No. Disability uses SDI Online; unemployment uses UI Online.
How often do unemployment claimants certify?
Is the applicant’s disability form enough?
No. EDD also needs the licensed health professional’s certification.
What if I quit or was fired?
EDD reviews unemployment eligibility; the reason requires assessment.
